items.question: How are service credits given to Voss-Lindqvist?
items.answer:
Service credits are given to Voss-Lindqvist AB based on the availability of services under the Master Services Agreement. Provider will make the Services available at least 99.5% of each calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance. For each full hour of unavailability below that level, Client will receive a service credit of five percent (5%) of the monthly subscription fee [1].

Service credits in any calendar month are capped at twenty-five percent (25%) of the monthly subscription fee for that month [1]. Service credits are applied against the next invoice and are not payable in cash [2].

evidence.quote: Provider will make the Services available at least 99.5% of each calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance notified at least five (5) business days in advance.
Service credits in any calendar month are capped at twenty-five percent (25%) of the monthly subscription fee for that month.
Credits will be applied against the next invoice and are not payable in cash.

items.question: Is liability for breach of confidentiality limited by the MSA's cap?
items.answer:

However, the liability cap does not apply to fraud, wilful misconduct, or breach of Clause 5, which relates to confidentiality [1].
